```yaml
name: Comment Artifacts

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["test-build.yml"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  comment-artifacts:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get PR number
        id: get_pr
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "HEAD_SHA=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "RUN_ID=${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "REPO=${{ github.repository }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          PR_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}/pulls?per_page=1")
          PR_NUMBER=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r '.[0].number')
          echo "PR_NUMBER=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: List artifacts
        id: list_artifacts
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          ARTIFACTS_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ env.RUN_ID }}/artifacts")
          echo "$ARTIFACTS_JSON" > artifacts.json
          MARKDOWN="## ISO artifacts\n\n"
          while read -r line; do
            NAME=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.name')
            URL=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.archive_download_url')
            MARKDOWN+="- [$NAME]($URL)\n"
          done < <(jq -c '.artifacts[]' artifacts.json)
          echo "$MARKDOWN" > comment.md
          echo "COMMENT_BODY=$(cat comment.md)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post or update comment
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          COMMENTS_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}/comments?per_page=100")
          COMMENT_ID=$(echo "$COMMENTS_JSON" | jq -r '.[] | select(.user.login=="github-actions[bot]") | select(.body | contains("## ISO artifacts")) | .id' | head -n 1)
          BODY=$(printf '%s' "${{ env.COMMENT_BODY }}" | jq -R .)
          if [ -n "$COMMENT_ID" ]; then
            curl -s -X PATCH -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"body\": $BODY}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID"
          else
            curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"body\": $BODY}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}/comments"
          fi
```
